units.source_text: 次夜祈祷之时，有一个鬼魂附在人身上出现了。

en.t: The next night, during the prayers, a ghost appeared by possessing a human body.

units.source_text: 这鬼魂言道：“请看我的法力如何！

en.t: The ghost said, "Now see how powerful my magic is!

units.source_text: 前些时我祟那一个人，被你们巧妙地救了去，我想起了好痛恨啊！

en.t: Not long ago I cursed that person, but you cleverly saved them, and when I think of it, I am filled with hatred!

units.source_text: 为此我悄悄地来到这里，陪了这个人好几天。

en.t: Because of that, I secretly came here and stayed beside this person for several days.

units.source_text: 现在我回去了。”说过之后笑起来。

en.t: Now I am going back." After saying this, it began to laugh.

units.source_text: 源氏大为吃惊，他想：“原来二条院中那个鬼魂来到了这里，不曾离去呢。”

en.t: Genji was greatly startled and thought, "So the ghost from the Nijo estate came here and never left."

units.source_text: 便觉得三公主实甚可怜可惜。

en.t: He then felt that the Third Princess was truly pitiful and deeply to be regretted.

units.source_text: 三公主的病已略见好转，然而还是难保安全。

en.t: The Third Princess's illness had already shown some improvement, but her safety still could not be assured.

units.source_text: 众侍女为了三公主出家，大家意气消沉。

en.t: All the ladies-in-waiting were dispirited because the Third Princess had taken religious vows.

units.source_text: 但念因此而得恢复健康，也是好的，便只得忍受了。

en.t: But thinking that it would be good if this allowed her to recover her health, they could only endure it.

units.source_text: 源氏延长了做法事的日子，命僧众郑重举办，照料无微不至。

en.t: Genji extended the days of the memorial rites, ordered the monks to conduct them with great solemnity, and attended to everything with the utmost care.
